headline: Executive order creates the Interagency Security Committee, a group of federal agencies that works on security for federal buildings.
what_it_does: This order sets up the Interagency Security Committee, which brings together several federal agencies to work on security. Its main job is to set security standards for buildings and offices used by the federal government. Only the title was provided, so this summary does not cover the order's specific rules or membership.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that own or rent office space
who_it_affects.how: They take part in or follow the committee's work on building security.

who_it_affects.group: Federal employees and visitors to federal buildings
who_it_affects.how: The security standards the committee develops may shape safety measures in the buildings where they work or visit.
